acceptance.given: Run the FR-8 aggregate evaluator with the historical-case relabel fixture while holding every other input constant.

oracle.expected: The aggregate evaluator returns rejection for the relabelled historical case, and the observed input comparison identifies only the relabel change.
forbidden: The aggregate is accepted when the case is relabelled.
Any non-label input changes between the baseline and relabel fixture.
oracle.observable: A deterministic evaluator/test invocation emits a structured aggregate decision of reject together with an input-difference record containing only the historical-case relabel field.

acceptance.then: The isolated historical relabel fixture is rejected by the aggregate evaluator.
acceptance.when: Given the canonical FR-8 aggregate evaluation path and its historical relabel fixture, execute the evaluation and inspect the structured decision and input-difference output.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the historical relabel fixture; fail when the aggregate evaluator reports acceptance instead of rejection.
Compare baseline and relabel fixture inputs; fail when any field besides the historical label differs or the evaluator omits the isolated-difference observation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the FR-8 aggregate replay evaluation reject the historical case when relabelled, while preserving all other fixture inputs and exposing the isolated relabel difference.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent schema or state change; reverting the replay evaluator change restores prior behavior without migration.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The structured FR-8 aggregate result is reject and the fixture comparison proves the relabel is the sole input difference.
